content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where platform restrictions and payment limitations are a harsh reality, building a digital store that accepts [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-9|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments can seem like an insurmountable challenge. However, with the right infrastructure, you can overcome these obstacles and start [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-first-principles-definitive-breakdown-3|Selling Notion]]-notion-templates-crypto-first-principles-definitive-breakdown-4|selling]] your digital products to a global audience. This guide will show you how to build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to building a successful crypto store lies in its infrastructure. By using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, you can create a robust and scalable platform that can handle a high volume of transactions. This infrastructure is particularly useful for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. With Stack 02, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, you can have a fully functional crypto store up and running in no time.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your crypto store, you need to have a few things in place. First, you need to have a clear understanding of what products you want to sell and how you want to price them. You also need to have a wallet set up to receive crypto payments and a basic understanding of how crypto transactions work. Additionally, you need to choose the right stack for your needs, whether it's Stack 01 or Stack 02, and have the necessary documentation and support in place.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your products and pricing in place, you can start setting up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating NOWPayments into your store, which allows you to accept over 300 different cryptocurrencies with a low fee of 0.5%. You also need to set up a system for delivering your digital products to customers, which can be done using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With the right payment and delivery pipeline in place, you can start processing transactions and delivering products to your customers.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your crypto store. This involves deploying your stack, whether it's Stack 01 or Stack 02, and configuring your payment layer. Once you're live, you can start processing transactions and delivering products to your customers. The first transaction is always the most exciting, and with the right infrastructure in place, you can be confident that it will be a success.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is up and running, you can start thinking about scaling. This involves optimizing your infrastructure for high traffic and large volumes of transactions. With Stack 02, you get end-to-end testing and 30-day support, which can help you identify and fix any issues that arise. You can also use the Sovereign Blueprint to scale your infrastructure and add new products and features to your store.
